title: Verify lead parity and retire the legacy intake copy
description:
Part of story chatticus-e50451 (group G1 of the consolidation plan). The live /api* origin is the new intake Lambda in the Chatticus account; its table has 2 items (1 waitlist, 1 contact) and the legacy production table has the same counts of those prefixes with no writes in 30 days. Compare the two pairs without printing values, record the result, then treat the legacy copy as retire material (it goes with the legacy production thin-turn table). Lead capture must not drop at any step. Owner decision needed: approve the comparison method.

Feature: Leads preserved
  Scenario: Parity confirmed
    Given the legacy and new intake items exist
    When their stored values are compared without being printed
    Then they match and the legacy copy may be retired

comments.author: home
comments.text: Lead parity check done 2026-10-26 (owner-approved method). Read the WAITLIST and CONTACT items from the legacy production messaging table and the new intake table, no values printed or stored. Each pair has the same attribute names; SHA-256 of the canonical business fields matches for both (WAITLIST and CONTACT); a per-attribute hash comparison including keys and timestamps also matched with zero differing attributes. Result: the migrated leads equal the legacy ones; the legacy copy may be retired with the legacy production thin-turn table (chatticus-8c0b25). No writes to either table.
